messages:
Lara (PM): Quick sync — we need to prioritize telemetry insights for Q2. Major asks: per-route cost breakdown, end-to-end tracing hooks, error analytics, and dashboard templates for product teams.
Anya (Design): +1. Customers asked for an opinionated dashboard — quick to pick and ship. Can we get presets for 'latency hotspots', 'cost by model', 'failed calls by route'?
Matt (Eng): From runtime POV: tracing hooks need lightweight spans, probably sample-based. Implementing full traces for every request will kill p99s unless we sample.
Ricardo (SRE): Agree on sampling. Also need a way to stitch traces across services — offer a correlation id header from API gateway.
Matt (Eng): Proposed header: `X-Redwood-Trace: <trace-id>` and we emit sampled spans to OTLP/Jaeger. Sampling default 2-5% but configurable per-customer.
Jess (Data): For cost breakdown we can derive tokens -> cost mapping. Need model catalog mapping and per-request metadata (route, model, quantization).
Lara (PM): Customer-driven asks: BankCorp wants chargeback-ready reports; StartApp needs real-time error alerts; Platform team wants SLA dashboards. We need to scope MVP.
Matt (Eng): Proposed MVP: (1) per-route aggregated cost metrics, (2) basic error counts + top error messages, (3) tracing hook header + sampled trace export to OTLP. No full trace UI in MVP.
Anya (Design): I'll mock 3 dashboard templates: Ops (latency/cost), Product (usage & cost), Reliability (errors & traces). Want to reuse existing chart components.
Ricardo (SRE): Launch criteria: p50/p95 impact <5% with tracing enabled, sampling <5% default, retention 30d for metrics, RBAC for cost views.
Lara (PM): Timeline? Q2 sprint1: backend metrics + hooks; sprint2: dashboards + alerting; sprint3: polish/reporting. We can move faster if we cut trace UI.
Jess (Data): Data infra notes: tag schema needed: customer_id, route, model_hash, quantized_flag, cost_estimate. Also need backfill plan for last 30 days.
Matt (Eng): Backfill is expensive. Offer exports for customers to import into BI. We'll do backfill for aggregated daily cost only.
Lara (PM): Scope negotiation: decide cuttable items — trace UI, per-token billing export, advanced anomaly detection.
Anya (Design): Can we ship dashboard templates without trace UI and still make customers happy? Probably yes, if dashboards surface sampled trace links to logs/external trace viewer.
Ricardo (SRE): Alerting MVP: threshold alerts on error rate and cost spike + webhook integration. No PagerDuty initially, just webhooks and email.
Lara (PM): OK decision: MVP = aggregated cost by route, error analytics + top errors, sampling-aware trace hooks + export, 3 dashboard templates, basic alerts. No full trace explorer, no per-token export, no anomaly detection.
Matt (Eng): Risks: model mapping inaccuracies (need model registry integration), KV cache tagging for requests, overhead on tail latency. We'll add observability feature flags for dogfooding.
Jess (Data): Metrics definitions doc needed. I'll draft and share schema + examples.
Lara (PM): Action items:
- Jess: metrics doc + backfill decision (due Wed)
- Matt: implement trace header + sampling + export (sprint1)
- Anya: dashboard mocks (sprint1)
- Ricardo: define SLO impact targets and alerting hooks (sprint1)
- Lara: customer comms + beta invites

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: telemetry-helpers v0.9.0 -> staging at 2026-03-25 02:00 UTC :rocket:
Matt (Eng): Noted, will run load tests after staged deploy.
Anya (Design): I'll do a quick usability session with Platform team after staging.
Lara (PM): Thanks everyone. I'll post a short PRD and a prioritization doc in the product channel by EOD.
